Purchase Invoice — Transactions

The Purchase Invoice transactions screen provides a detailed view of all financial activity related to a specific purchase invoice.

This screen helps you track payments made against the invoice and monitor the outstanding balance due.

What This Screen Shows

For each purchase invoice, you can view:

• The original invoice amount and date

• All payments made against the invoice

• Any adjustments, credit notes, or debit notes applied

• The current balance due to the supplier

Making Payments

Click the New Payment button to record a payment against this invoice.

The payment will automatically be linked to this purchase invoice, reducing the balance due.
